candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey convulse now. Pikin never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything. Dis pikin na 11 months old. Pikin get cough or e dey get wahala to breathe. Pikin no get diarrhoea. Pikin no get problem for ear. Pikin no get fever. Dem count how pikin dey breathe for one full minute. Pikin chest no dey go inside when e dey breathe. Dem check am when pikin calm. Pikin don dey cough for 3 days. Dem no get pulse oximeter for here. Pikin no dey get wheeze wey dey come back. Pikin dey breathe 50 times for one minute. Pikin no dey make stridor sound when e calm. Pikin no dey wheeze.
